description: Connects ONLINE to the physical PLC. GATE G4: pass confirm:true (after a human confirms it's safe to connect to the target machine); without it, returns a handoff. The confirm:true call must repeat the SAME connectionMode, pcInterfaceName, pcInterfaceNumber and targetInterfaceName as the approved plan: without connectionMode or pcInterfaceName it is refused (connection_fields_required) and nothing is sent. Maps to POST /plcs/{plc}/online.
name: tia_online
title: TIA — go online (GATE G4)
